anatomy.flutter: field.dart exports exactly seven widgets: FieldGroup, FieldSet, FieldLegend, Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError (plus internal FieldScope/FieldActivator). FieldLegend has no variant parameter at all — it hardcodes the 'label' rendering ('mb-1.5 font-medium text-sm').

FieldLegend takes `variant: 'legend' | 'label'` (defaultVariants: legend) with `data-[variant=label]:text-sm data-[variant=legend]:text-base`.

disabled.flutter: Field.enabled cascades via FieldScope.enabled; FieldLabel wraps itself in `Disabled(disabled: true, blockPointer: false, child: label)` when not enabled, and Field.disabledReason is 'Shown as a tooltip on hover (pointer) or tap (touch) while disabled'.
disabled.web: FieldLabel: `group-data-[disabled=true]/field:opacity-50` (field.tsx:112) and FieldTitle: same opacity-50 rule (field.tsx:126) — both driven off the enclosing Field's `data-disabled` via the `group/field` selector.

interaction.flutter: FieldLabel resolves a tap through an explicit precedence ladder documented in the file: onTap prop, then FieldScope.activator.callback, then FieldScope.focusNode.requestFocus(), then no recognizer at all — replacing the DOM's implicit `<label for>` activation behaviour with an id-graph-free callback registry (FieldActivator).
interaction.web: FieldLabel renders a real `<Label>` (Radix, which is a native `<label>`); `<label for=id>` natively activates/focuses the associated control on click with zero JS, per the field doc page's Accessibility section: 'FieldLabel renders a real <label>; pass htmlFor matching the control's id.'
interaction.note: Documented, deliberate platform difference: Flutter has no DOM id graph to build a native `<label for>` relationship, so field.dart substitutes a manual FieldActivator callback ladder (see field.dart:513-536 library doc, 'What a tap does, in order') to reproduce the same activation behaviour without an id system. This is the right mechanism for the platform, not a defect.

semantics.flutter: Field.build wraps the whole field in one `Semantics(container: true, validationResult: isInvalid ? invalid : none)` node, and the doc comment states the wiring is deliberately COLLAPSED into 'one merged semantics node per field' because 'Flutter has no id graph and no way to grow one' — description+error text is concatenated into one `Semantics(hint:)` string.
